detachWorktree.title: Worktree
detachWorktree.hint: Detaching removes this task's working folder and keeps its branch ({branch}) with its commits; the task gets a new folder on that branch when it runs again. Refused if the folder has uncommitted changes.
detachWorktree.confirm: Remove this task's working folder? Its branch and commits are kept.

markMerged.title: Merged outside Rooks?
markMerged.hint: If this task's branch was already merged (a pull request merged on GitHub, a merge by hand), give the merge commit: the task is closed as done and the tasks that depend on it start.
markMerged.doneUnverified: Task marked as merged. This commit is not in the local copy of the repository yet, so it could not be checked.
markMerged.notInBase: This commit is not in the base branch of the repository. Check the sha of the merge.
markMerged.failed: Could not mark the task as merged: {error}
markMerged.hintDone: This task is done but its branch never went through a merge in Rooks. If it was merged elsewhere (a pull request merged on GitHub, a merge by hand), give the merge commit: it is recorded and the tasks that depend on it start.

sequentialHere.title: Sequential — in this mission
sequentialHere.detail: The agent handles the workstreams here in this conversation. No Kanban task or worktree is created.

sequentialNewMission.title: Sequential — new mission
sequentialNewMission.detail: The same chained execution is handed to a fresh mission context while this conversation waits for the summary.

full.head: Full pipeline
full.title: Kanban — code → review → merge
full.detail: One code task per workstream in parallel worktrees, each reviewed and merged. The safest option for overnight work.

codeSelf.head: Code only
codeSelf.title: Kanban — code only, merge as you go
codeSelf.detail: One code task per workstream without review; each coder merges its branch when finished.

codeGroup.head: Code only
codeGroup.title: Kanban — code only, grouped merge
codeGroup.detail: One code task per workstream without review; a final merge task consolidates the branches.
